Name: Aspect of Aymere
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: A manifestation of Aymere is a rare occurance, but when he does choose to appear he generally chooses to produce his aspects from naturally occuring elements, such as a tree contorting into his image or earth forming into his body. Aymere can often appear as a threatening figure, but in almost all cases it appears only ensure the perseverance of natural life. To battle against an aspect of Aymere is to battle the environment itself: they can possess the environment, rapidly restore their health, and give chase to their targets by emerging from any macrofauna they choose.

traits.description: Aymere regains 20 (3d12) hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he is below half his maximum hit points this increases to 33 (5d12) instead.

traits.name: Uninhibited Growth (Mythic Awakening)

A party that defeats Aymere after using his Uninhibited Overgrowth is awarded an additional 155,000 XP (310,000 XP total).

actions.name: Scythe of Bright Harvest
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 feet, one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage. If this weapon hits an undead creature it deals an additional 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Entangle
actions.description: Aymere chooses up to three targets he can see within 30 feet of the ground or a plant, each of which can be no further than 20 feet from another target. Vines spring from each, forcing that creature to make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure that creature is restrained, and breaking free requires an action to make a DC 21 Strength check, escaping on a success. The vines can also be attacked - they have an AC of 21, and are immune to all damage except slashing, acid, force, and fire. They will break if 30 or more damage is dealt to them in a single turn. Aymere can only bind up to ten creatures this way.

actions.name: Godfelling Miasma (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: A sickening miasma covers the area around Aymere, swirling in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on him. Aymere can reduce the sphere to as small as a 10-foot-radius, and may exclude fey, beast, and plant creatures of its choice from the effect. Each creature in range must succeed a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (8d12) poison damage on a failed save. Creatures that fail are poisoned permanently, requiring a 9th-level spell or some equivalent to recover. Poisoned creatures also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns for 1 minute, ending the effect on a successful save, and taking 2d10 poison damage on a failure. If they fail these saves for a full minute they stop making these ongoing saving throws.

bonus_actions.description: Aymere’s body becomes a tree of the same size he currently is, while he possesses a medium or larger tree within 240 feet. The tree twists to become Aymere new body, and he becomes the size of the tree he possessed.

**ASPECT OF AYMERE**
*Huge humanoid (minotaur), neutral good*
**Armor Class** 20 (natural armor)
**Hit Points** 540 (40d12 + 280)
**Speed** 40 ft., burrow 80 ft.
**Quality Traits** Deific, magic resist
**STR** 24 (+7) | **DEX** 14 (+2) | **CON** 24 (+7) | **INT** 16 (+3) | **WIS** 30 (+10) | **CHA** 21 (+5)
**Saving Throws** Dex +11, Con +16, Int +12, Wis +19
**Skills** Nature +19, Perception +19
**Resistances** B/S/P (eidolic)
**Immunities** poison; B/S/P (eidolic or magical)
**Condition Immunities** charmed, exhaustion, paralyzed, poisoned
**Senses** truesight 60 ft., darkvision 240 ft., tremorsense 1000 ft., passive Perception 29
**Languages** all
**Challenge Rating** 30 (150,000 XP) **Prof Bonus** +9

***Innate Spellcasting.*** Aymere’s spellcasting ability is Wisdom. He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
• ***At will:*** gravity bind, greater restoration, plant growth, tree stride
• ***1/Day each:*** earthquake, lashing willow, reincarnate, sunburst
• ***2/Day each:*** heal
• ***3/Day each:*** corrosive smite, flash cure, heal

When Aymere casts any spell from the whispering tome with limited uses, he can spend two of its Legendary Actions for that round to cast it at 9th level.

**LEGENDARY REACTIONS (4 USES)**
TBA.

***Regeneration.*** Aymere regains 20 (3d12) hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he is below half his maximum hit points this increases to 33 (5d12) instead.

***Uninhibited Growth (Mythic Awakening).*** When he is reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, Aymere instead resets to 400 and it grows to a size of Colossal (or whatever the maximum size he can grow to in this space is), his reach increases by 20 feet with all attacks, and he regains all uses of its Legendary Resistance and Innate Spellcasting. For 1 hour, he can use his Mythic Actions, and any spell he casts that has limited uses is cast at 9th level. For that same hour, his regeneration ceases to function. A party that defeats Aymere after using his Uninhibited Overgrowth is awarded an additional 155,000 XP (310,000 XP total).

**ACTIONS**
***Multiattack.*** Aymere makes three weapon attacks: one with his Horns, and two with his Scythe of Bright Harvest. He can replace his Horn attack with using Entangle.

***Horns.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 5 feet, one target. *Hit:* 40 (6d10 + 7) piercing damage.

***Scythe of Bright Harvest.*** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +16 to hit, reach 10 feet, one target. *Hit:* 20 (2d12 + 7) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) poison damage. If this weapon hits an undead creature it deals an additional 11 (2d10) radiant damage.

***Entangle.*** Aymere chooses up to three targets he can see within 30 feet of the ground or a plant, each of which can be no further than 20 feet from another target. Vines spring from each, forcing that creature to make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure that creature is restrained, and breaking free requires an action to make a DC 21 Strength check, escaping on a success. The vines can also be attacked - they have an AC of 21, and are immune to all damage except slashing, acid, force, and fire. They will break if 30 or more damage is dealt to them in a single turn. Aymere can only bind up to ten creatures this way.

***Godfelling Miasma (Recharge 5-6).*** A sickening miasma covers the area around Aymere, swirling in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on him. Aymere can reduce the sphere to as small as a 10-foot-radius, and may exclude fey, beast, and plant creatures of its choice from the effect. Each creature in range must succeed a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (8d12) poison damage on a failed save. Creatures that fail are poisoned permanently, requiring a 9th-level spell or some equivalent to recover. Poisoned creatures also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns for 1 minute, ending the effect on a successful save, and taking 2d10 poison damage on a failure. If they fail these saves for a full minute they stop making these ongoing saving throws.

**BONUS ACTIONS**
***Tree Possession.*** Aymere’s body becomes a tree of the same size he currently is, while he possesses a medium or larger tree within 240 feet. The tree twists to become Aymere new body, and he becomes the size of the tree he possessed.

**LEGENDARY ACTIONS (3 ACTIONS)**
***Tree Stride.*** Aymere uses its Tree Possession.

***Create Nature.*** Aymere causes up to six trees of Huge to Gargantuan size to appear within 60 feet of him. He chooses a point for each, and each creature that would be in that tree’s space must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (3d8) bludgeoning damage. The trees push all creatures in their space into the nearest unoccupied space.

***Wild Terrain (Costs 2 Actions).*** Harsh winds kick up, water becomes turbulent, and the earth around Aymere becomes rough. Until the start of Aymere’s next turn, all terrain within 60 feet of him is considered difficult terrain, and creatures that enter a space within that range for the first time on their turn must succeed a DC 21 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

**MYTHIC ACTIONS**
Aymere can use the following as Legendary Action options for 1 hour after activating his Mythic Awakening.

***Cast Spell (Costs 2 Actions).*** Aymere casts any spell with a casting time of 1 action or faster using his Innate Spellcasting.

***Sweep.*** The aspect makes a Scythe of Bright Harvest attack against all creatures within the weapon’s reach, using the result of a single attack roll in place of each individual one.
